decision.explanation: The album title 'Lazy Afternoon' refers to two distinct works by different artists. Source D1S1 explicitly identifies 'A Lazy Afternoon' as a studio album by Harold Land. Source D2S1 explicitly identifies 'Lazy Afternoon' as a studio album recorded by Barbra Streisand. Both are valid answers to the question as they represent distinct valid namesakes (different albums with the same title) supported by the provided documents.
